notes.title: Update 3.3
notes.content:
Update 3.3 is live!

With this update we've added rock fall events, new hit animations, icons, and new magic particles - along with various minor improvements. Most importantly, we've added doors to Gleaming Liberty - impressive stuff. 

As always, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update 3.2
notes.content:
Hello friends - Patch 3.2 is live!

This update brings a bunch of fixes, tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements, along with some new content.

Most notably, we’ve added traits to character creation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206757/4582e7b63e0e7e4f1c868053b9b790a8b6abdf09.png[/img]

as well as new mechanics to the bosses in the Shifting Caverns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39206757/92517a9acca50e949fd0f30dfc0cf20a370e67c1.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy the changes! As always, let us know what you think.

notes.title: Update 3.1 - The Shifting Caverns
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We at [b]Sinking Ship Studios[/b] are excited to finally share the demo for our single-player fantasy RPG, [i][b]Shaype[/b][/i].

This demo takes you into The Shifting Caverns—the first level of the game—where you’ll get a taste of what we’re building for the early access release.

Give it a go and let us know what you think, your feedback means a lot to us. Thanks for checking it out and we hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Patch 1.10.0
notes.content:
[b]Notable Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Many misc issues after updating the engine version.
[*] Many misc AI behavior issues.
[*] Various performance tweaks.
[*] Camera zoom getting stuck with swinging.
[*] Camera sensitivity and input queue settings are now saved independently of savegame.
[*] Music / ambience volume jumps when fading between tracks.
[*] Ranged weapons unsheathe when trying to aim.
[*] Fixed tab not closing inventory when clicking on an item.
[*] Framerate should have less impact on mouse input delay.
[/list]

[b]Notable Changes / Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blocking is now only 2 angles, left and right. Shields block all 4 angles.
[*] Chambering mechanic added, it's explained in the tutorial (essentially old 4 angle parry but via swinging).
[*] Made Flintlocks ragdoll enemies. 
[*] Timing changes for blocking and feinting.
[*] Increased swing speeds.
[*] Sped up reload times for crossbows and flintlocks. 
[*] Added options for middle / bottom angle and shoulder indicator.
[*] Favoriting no longer requires the favorite button.
[*] Reworked input for angle selection. 
[*] Parries no longer have a chance, they are now purely based on a time threshold. 
[*] AI can now dual block.
[*] Tweaked AI movement in combat.
[*] Added hybrid NPCs that can use both ranged and melee weaponry.
[*] Added some testing voice lines to NPCs - Take Damage, Taunts, etc.
[*] Added biome support with different music, ambience, and misc other effects.
[*] Created cycle for sun / moon lighting.
[*] Player no longer collides with dead bodies. 
[*] Volumetric clouds.
[*] Added support for reading books / notes.
[*] Herobrine removed.
[/list]

Check out our [url=https://discord.gg/Q8wFNMA]Discord[/url] If you want to get involved in Shaype's development.

notes.title: Patch 1.9.1
notes.content:
Notable Fixes:
-NPCs dealing damage during the windup phase of swing.
-Feint delay added for manual feint key. Spamming the feint key won’t break swinging anymore.
-Issue of weapon hitbox enabling after feint.
-Some enchantment description issues.
-Post Process quality can no longer be lower than “2” in options. This led to lighting issues.
-Issue with character's spine movement from receiving a block to swinging.
Notable Changes:
-Tweaked duration of animation blending for default poses.
-Feinting should be much easier, increased the period of time a feint can occur in windup.
-NPC collision ignores dead bodies.
-Increased grass draw distance.
-Made NPCs attack speed a bit slower.

notes.title: Update 1.9.0
notes.content:
Notable Fixes:
-Some camera speed issues when swings / blocks overlap or get cancelled.
-Some inconsistency for AI reacting to swings / feints.

Notable Additions:
-New swing animations / default two handed stance.
-New TP camera positions for melee combat.
-Tweaked how angle is chosen for swinging / blocking.
-AI now have different attack radii based on weapon type.
-Keys R and F used for Dropping / Favoriting items.
-Cleaned up item details, better enchantment descriptions.
-New fonts.
-Some UI sounds for inventory.
-Right click cancel aim for ranged .
-Dead faces.
-New maul and axe models.
-New grass.
-Basic Discord integration, to show details about the state of the game while playing it.
-Added quick-load F9.
-Improved armor / weapon models
-Reduced block delay

notes.title: Changelog 1.8.0
notes.content:

[*] Fixed ragdolling while flinching.
[*] Temporarily removed stat scaling from combatants.
[*] Bug from holding RMB / LMB at same time and releasing in certain order.
